response.original_title: {Eanhenced@Guide}How to change your rooms or cabins on Norwegian Cruise?
response.overview: o add a Room to an existing Norwegian Cruises booking, you must call Norwegian Customer Service directly at 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel advisor, as additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app  To add a another Room to an existing Norwegian Cruise reservation +1-(866)-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, you must call Carnival Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly +1-(866)-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a Room to an Norwegian Cruise online +1-(866)-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, so you must contact Carnival customer service or your travel agent directly by phone +1-(866)-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151. To add a guest to an existing Norwegian Cruise booking +1-(866)-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
